conclusion.requirement: Performance 100 remains open for both current viewports. Other three categories are 100 in both.
conclusion.mobile: Five raw wall-long tasks versus one; all tasks have recorded CPU below 50 ms. Initial layout and paint dominate the longest task, with similar recorded CPU and layout object counts. app.js evaluation CPU did not increase. No compositeFailed or clock pulse animation was captured.
conclusion.desktop: Four raw wall-long tasks versus one. Largest task is a two-microtask event without direct stack evidence; recorded thread CPU is 6.410 ms despite 264.240 ms wall. Existing noncomposited animation event/property counts are unchanged; no clock pulse animation or halo failure was captured.
conclusion.nextAction: Retain unchanged acceptance gate and namespace correction, document valid failed measurements and attribution limits. These captures do not justify another speculative app/CSS modification or a rerun solely to seek a score.
